policy.amount: Currency amount including written currency name or symbol; not separately counted as number.
policy.spelled_sequence: Explicit dictated sequence of letters; ordinary acronyms and abbreviations alone do not establish a spelling task.
policy.comparison: Case-sensitive; preserve punctuation/digits/spelling; ignore whitespace only; no semantic equivalences or WER normalization.
